claims.statement: EU business guidance states that a business which fulfilled its contractual obligations can claim interest and recovery-cost compensation on overdue B2B and public-authority payments, subject to applicable conditions.

contrary_evidence: The cited rules exclude insolvency proceedings and compensation-for-damages claims, and cross-border contracts may be governed by chosen law.
A right to interest does not establish claim assignability, debtor solvency, or economical recovery.

economics.acquisition_route: Accountant and bookkeeping referrals, contractor software integrations, and renewable-trade networks
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A possible path is a national accountant-led claim flow producing several million PLN in annual contingency revenue plus underwriting-quality payment data
economics.founder_time: Initially 10-16 hours per week, with contested litigation handled by licensed counsel
economics.gross_margin_basis: Expected 50-70% after legal partner fees, failed-case work, identity checks, and support
economics.payback: Unknown; depends on average claim, recovery rate, and duration, with no plan to purchase debt initially
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 10-20% contingency on recovered principal, interest, and permitted compensation; optional 200-500 PLN monthly prevention tier
economics.retention_or_repeat: SMEs may submit repeated invoices, though success should ideally reduce recurring delinquency

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A growing mandate flow, debtor payment-behavior data, evidence templates, and legal routing improve recovery prediction and acquisition
fingerprint.customer: Polish installers, contractors, agencies, and small service firms with overdue business or public-sector invoices
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accountants, bookkeepers, trade software, installer networks, and the family company's supplier and contractor ecosystem
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Invoice and delivery-evidence intake, automated lawful reminders, interest calculation, settlement workflow, and escalation through a licensed legal partner
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The creditor pays 10-20% of recovered amounts only after money is received, with legal disbursements agreed separately
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A customer has missed the contractual due date and the SME lacks time or leverage to pursue payment consistently

founder_fit: Automation and recovery prediction suit data and finance skills
Family-business experience provides authentic access to contractor pain
Contingency pricing is testable without buying receivables
risks: Aggressive collection could damage customers or violate debtor protections
Disputed or fraudulent invoices can create legal exposure
Legal-service and debt-collection rules require specialist structuring
Long recovery cycles can create poor unit economics

structure.control_point: Contractual collection mandates or assignments over specific documented invoices
structure.critical_dependency: Claims must be valid and assignable, debtors solvent, evidence complete, and collection activity lawfully structured

thesis: Take documented collection mandates or assignments for overdue B2B invoices from Polish trade and installation SMEs, automate evidence packs and escalation, and earn a contingency share only when principal, interest, or recovery compensation is collected.
title: Assigned SME Receivables Recovery Engine
uncertainties: Polish assignment and collection licensing requirements are unverified
Unknown recovery rate and average recoverable balance in the target channel
No debtor-contact workflow has been legally reviewed
